label: CRP gene (Ensembl ENSG00000132693)
definition: Gene for C-reactive protein; made in the liver, so absent from lymphoblastoid RNA (Geuvadis).

label: TNF gene (Ensembl ENSG00000232810)
definition: Gene for tumour necrosis factor, a central pro-inflammatory cytokine.

label: IL6 gene (Ensembl ENSG00000136244)
definition: Gene for interleukin-6, the cytokine that drives CRP production in the liver.

label: IL10 gene (Ensembl ENSG00000136634)
definition: Gene for interleukin-10, an anti-inflammatory cytokine.

label: C-reactive protein (UniProt P02741)
definition: C-reactive protein: acute-phase protein, the standard blood marker of systemic inflammation.

label: Tumor necrosis factor (UniProt P01375)
definition: Tumour necrosis factor: pro-inflammatory cytokine, target of anti-TNF therapies.

label: Interleukin-6 (UniProt P05231)
definition: Interleukin-6: pro-inflammatory cytokine that induces CRP.

label: Interleukin-10 (UniProt P22301)
definition: Interleukin-10: anti-inflammatory cytokine.

label: Serum CRP (LOINC 1988-5)
definition: Serum CRP by immunoturbidimetry (Lab A), mg/L.

label: Serum hs-CRP (LOINC 30522-7)
definition: Serum CRP by high-sensitivity immunoassay (Lab B), mg/L.

label: Olink CRP (NPX)
definition: Olink proximity extension assay for CRP; NPX is log2 relative and never converted.

label: Olink TNF (NPX)
definition: Olink proximity extension assay for TNF; NPX (log2 relative).

label: Olink IL6 (NPX)
definition: Olink proximity extension assay for IL-6; NPX (log2 relative).

label: Olink IL10 (NPX)
definition: Olink proximity extension assay for IL-10; NPX (log2 relative).

label: ERAP2 gene (Ensembl ENSG00000164308)
definition: Gene for ERAP2; the rs2248374-G allele sends its mRNA to nonsense-mediated decay.

label: rs2248374 (dbSNP)
definition: ERAP2 splice variant (A>G): G/G people make almost no ERAP2 (strong eQTL).

label: rs1205 (dbSNP)
definition: CRP 3' UTR variant (C>T) associated with circulating CRP levels.

label: rs1800629 (dbSNP)
definition: TNF promoter variant -308 G/A.

label: rs1800795 (dbSNP)
definition: IL6 promoter variant -174 G/C.

label: rs1800896 (dbSNP)
definition: IL10 promoter variant -1082 A/G.

label: ERAP2 expression (RNA-seq)
definition: RNA-seq expression of ERAP2 in lymphoblastoid cells (Geuvadis), nRPKM.

label: TNF expression (RNA-seq)
definition: RNA-seq expression of TNF in lymphoblastoid cells (Geuvadis), nRPKM.

label: IL6 expression (RNA-seq)
definition: RNA-seq expression of IL6 in lymphoblastoid cells (Geuvadis), nRPKM.

label: IL10 expression (RNA-seq)
definition: RNA-seq expression of IL10 in lymphoblastoid cells (Geuvadis), nRPKM.
